title: Modrinth Themed Mojang Loading Screen
description: Change your mc loading screen to a modrinth themed one just like the one showed on the Modrinth homepage
body:
# Modrinth Themed Loading Screen
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Reversal_-5865F2?style=flat&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/jxQtq3XBKv)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-IamSboby-181717?style=flat&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/IamSboby)

A clean **Modrinth-inspired loading screen** resource pack for Minecraft, designed to recreate the look and feel of the official Modrinth homepage.

This pack replaces the default Minecraft loading screen with a modern, minimal, green-themed design inspired by Modrinth’s visual identity.

## Preview

![actual in-game screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/420410f4a2e132bde1b417e7c9360a5d0b23c9d7.png)

## Features

- Modrinth-style custom loading screen
- Modern dark background with bright green accents
- Clean and lightweight visual design
- Inspired by the Modrinth homepage aesthetic
- Improves the default Minecraft loading experience
- Simple resource pack with no gameplay changes

## Requirements

This resource pack requires **OptiFine** or **OptiGUI** to work properly and display correctly.

At least one of them must be installed and active.  
Without **OptiFine** or **OptiGUI**, some visual elements may not appear as intended.

## Installation

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Open Minecraft.
3. Go to:

   `Options → Resource Packs → Open Pack Folder`

4. Place the `.zip` file inside the resource packs folder.
5. Enable the resource pack in Minecraft.
6. Make sure **OptiFine** or **OptiGUI** is installed and active.

## Compatibility

This resource pack is intended to work with Minecraft versions supported by **OptiFine** or **OptiGUI**.

For the best experience, use the latest compatible version of either OptiFine or OptiGUI for your Minecraft version.

## Notes

This pack only changes the visual appearance of the loading screen.  
It does not modify gameplay, blocks, items, mobs, menus, or game mechanics.

## What Is This Resource Pack?

**Modrinth Themed Loading Screen** is a Minecraft resource pack that replaces the default loading screen with a custom design inspired by Modrinth. It is made for players who want a cleaner, more modern, and more polished startup/loading screen while keeping the game lightweight and simple.
